def isScramble(S1, S2):
    n = len(S1)
    if n != len(S2):
        return False
    if n == 0:
        return True
    if sorted(S1) != sorted(S2):
        return False
    for i in range(1, n):
        if (isScramble(S1[:i], S2[:i]) and isScramble(S1[i:], S2[i:])) or \
           (isScramble(S1[:i], S2[-i:]) and isScramble(S1[i:], S2[:-i])):
            return True
    return False
